t: A pocket handheld game board with a thumbstick that you program yourself.
steps: Buy the PyGamer from Adafruit for about 45 US dollars or look for the PyGamer Starter Kit.
Add button caps, a small speaker and a small rechargeable battery to your order.
Get a micro-USB data cable to connect it to your computer.
Open MakeCode Arcade in your web browser.
Build a simple sprite game from the starter tutorials.
Download the game and drag the file onto the PyGamer drive.
Try CircuitPython next with the Mu editor and the Adafruit Learn guide.
meta: Wild Open. From $44.95. A few stores.
